conditions.runtime: FTB Quests 2001.4.22 is installed and a real server player logs in.

change.summary: Keep the universal authored quest book available by reconciling the native FTB team lock at login.

modifiers.before: A persisted or newly resolved native team may retain locked=true and make every entry report Quests locked!.
modifiers.after: The existing optional JEMAchievementGuide FTB adapter waits for FTB Teams to resolve the exact team on login or team change, then calls TeamData.setLocked(false), saves only when the value changed and synchronizes that native TeamData to the affected player. Native FTB progress, rewards and claims remain authoritative.

rationale.purpose: Make the requested unlocked quest state durable without replacing FTB Quests or rewriting progression.
rationale.decision_source: User reported that all quests still show locked after the earlier operational recovery. Codex selected the exact installed public TeamData API and login seam after inspecting FTB Quests 2001.4.22 bytecode.

introduced.summary: Clear and save only a changed native FTB team lock when its player logs in.

history.summary: Replace one-time command recovery with an idempotent native login reconciliation.
Move reconciliation from the earlier Forge player-login event to FTB Teams' resolved login/team-change boundary and synchronize the result on the following server tick.

relations: FTB Teams resolved login or team change -> exact native FTB TeamData -> unlocked quest presentation
notes: The following-tick reconciliation runs after FTB Quests' own login synchronization and sends the corrected native TeamData directly to the affected player.
unresolved: Player-visible acceptance remains pending after deployment.
